info.description:
Trama's REST API. Authenticate with an organization API key, created under Settings → Developers, and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or in the `x-api-key` header).

Every key is bound to ONE organization: everything this API returns and everything it writes stays inside that organization, and no request ever names it.

Errors always come back as `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. Branch on `code` — it is stable; the `message` text is not.
